meaning:
εἶδος, -ους, τό,
[in LXX for מַרְאֶה,, etc. ;]
1. that which is seen, appearance, external form: Luk.3:22 9:29, Jhn.5:37, 2Co.5:7 (ICC in l.).

elsewhere.note: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
for we walk by faith, not by sight.
Abstain from every form of evil.
